newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end down slightly.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end down slightly.

text.p: Colombian stocks dipped slightly in regular trading dominated by foreign fund activity, brokers said.

Bogota's IBB price index closed down 0.28 percent at 1,193.93 on volume of 2.8 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED general price index finished down 0.24 percent at 18,163.89 on volume of 1.8 billion pesos.
Foreign funds traded heavily in stocks belonging to the Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, brokers said.
Cemento Argos was unchanged at 8,500 on volume of 1.1 billion pesos in Bogota.
Banco Industrial Colombiano remained at 3,900 on volume of 656 million and held at 3,901 in Medellin.
Investors waiting for more first half earnings reports may have caused lackluster trading in Medellin, brokers said.
The most heavily traded Medellin stock was Almacenes Exito, which finished down 0.26 percent to 3,840.
Cementos Caribe also traded heavily in Medellin, steady at 5,850 on volume of 270 million pesos and unchanged at 5,829 in Bogota.
